import collections, json, pathlib, re, subprocess
turn = "quadratic_bottom_branching_audit_20260914_138"
dest = pathlib.Path("research/results") / turn
entry_id = "entry-2026-09-14-quadratic-bottom-affine-branches"
html = pathlib.Path("notebook.html").read_text()
old = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", "HEAD:notebook.html"], text=True)
marker = "<!-- Append new dated mathematical entries here, preserving earlier entries. -->"
start = '<article class="research-entry"'
entry_start = start + ' id="' + entry_id + '">'
assert old[old.index(start):old.index(marker)] == html[html.index(start):html.index(entry_start)]
entry = html[html.index(entry_start):html.index(marker)]
ids = collections.Counter(re.findall(r'\bid="([^"]+)"', html))
links = re.findall(r'href="#([^"]+)"', entry)
assert all(ids[a] == 1 for a in links + [entry_id])
assert html.count("<!-- TIMING " + turn + " -->") == 1
counts = collections.Counter()
certificates = collections.Counter()
source_images = collections.Counter()
models = collections.Counter()
summaries = []
with (dest / "NS-affine-branches.jsonl").open() as source:
    for line in source:
        item = json.loads(line)
        counts[item["record"]] += 1
        if "passed" in item:
            assert item["passed"] is True
        if item["record"] == "NS_certificate":
            certificates[item["accuracy"]] += 1
            if "source_axiom" in item:
                source_images[item["accuracy"]] += 1
        if item["record"] == "model":
            models[item["name"]] += 1
        if item["record"] in ("summary", "case_summary"):
            summaries.append(item)
assert certificates == {1: 59, 2: 49}
assert source_images == {1: 33, 2: 23}
assert models == {"canonical": 64, "missing_branch_companion": 2}
assert counts["wrong_branch_control"] == counts["insufficient_coordinates_control"] == 2
assert summaries[-1]["NS_certificates"] == 108
result = {
    "session": turn, "record_counts": dict(counts),
    "certificates_by_accuracy": dict(certificates),
    "source_images_by_accuracy": dict(source_images),
    "models": dict(models), "summaries": summaries,
    "previous_research_record_unchanged": True,
    "entry_internal_links_checked": len(links),
    "unique_timing_placeholder": True, "passed": True
}
with (dest / "check-metadata.json").open("x") as target:
    json.dump(result, target, indent=2)
    target.write("\n")
print(json.dumps(result, indent=2))
